description: Implementation roadmap for the PhotoAlbum Azure modernization plan. Assessment issue titles are included in each applicable task description.

tasks.description: Upgrade PhotoAlbum and its test projects to .NET 10 and align framework dependencies. Addresses assessment issues: None; this task addresses the user's requested runtime upgrade.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requests a .NET 10 upgrade, and both application and test projects currently target net9.0.
tasks.requirements: Target net10.0 in PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj and PhotoAlbum.Tests/PhotoAlbum.Tests.csproj; upgrade compatible EF Core and ASP.NET Core test dependencies to the .NET 10 line; verify ImageSharp and other packages remain supported; update Dockerfile SDK/runtime images if retained. Preserve application behavior and verify build and unit tests.

tasks.description: Capture the current application behavior and freeze a test specification before Azure service transformations. Addresses assessment issues: None; this task establishes the verification baseline.
tasks.reason: Integration verification is included using the questionnaire default, so baseline behavior and dependency test strategy must be recorded before migration.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the PhotoAlbum/ source directory. Record existing gallery, upload, photo retrieval, delete, and authorization behavior in the frozen baseline. Use mocked Azure dependencies because no provisioned Azure test environment was identified; record each dependency's real/mock decision in the baseline infra-decision-table.

tasks.description: Align the hosting definition with the recommended Azure App Service target. Addresses assessment issues: None; the assessment did not report a hosting-platform defect.
tasks.reason: The current deployment definition selects Container Apps, while the project's preferred target is a simpler App Service deployment.
tasks.requirements: Update the hosting configuration to describe Azure App Service rather than Container Apps and remove or adapt Container Apps/ACR-specific settings. Review infra/main.bicep and azure.yaml for resource and deployment changes, and review Dockerfile usage against the selected App Service deployment method. This plan does not provision resources or deploy the application; confirm networking and existing-resource impacts before implementation.

tasks.description: Move photo file persistence from local disk to private Azure Blob Storage. Addresses assessment issues: Local or network IO operations detected.
tasks.reason: The current upload, retrieval, and deletion flows depend on instance-local files, while the existing Azure deployment already describes Blob Storage.
tasks.requirements: Preserve photo upload validation, metadata, retrieval, and deletion behavior while replacing local filesystem persistence with Azure Blob Storage and managed identity. Review PhotoAlbum/Services/IPhotoService.cs, PhotoService.cs, PhotoAlbum/Pages/PhotoFile.cshtml.cs, PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/appsettings.json, and infra/main.bicep. Define how existing local files are migrated and keep blob/database operations consistent. Keep the blob container private and use least-privilege data roles.

tasks.description: Connect the application to Azure SQL using managed identity and separate secrets from runtime settings. Addresses assessment issues: Local application configuration detected; Connection string is detected; SQL database connection detected; Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: The application configuration and legacy Web.config contain LocalDB settings, while the existing Azure design uses Azure SQL and a managed identity.
tasks.requirements: Use Azure SQL Database with the existing EF data model and managed identity; remove stale LocalDB connection strings from deployed configuration and Web.config. Use Azure App Configuration for non-secret settings and Key Vault for any remaining secrets, accessed with managed identity. Review PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/appsettings.json, PhotoAlbum/Web.config, infra/main.bicep, and scripts/configure-sql-user.*. Do not store credentials or connection strings in source control.

tasks.description: Use Microsoft Entra ID to authenticate administrators who perform protected operations. Addresses assessment issues: None; the reported hardcoded-sensitive-data finding was not confirmed as a hardcoded password.
tasks.reason: The current application has a single local admin sign-in flow; a managed identity does not replace end-user authentication.
tasks.requirements: Replace or integrate the local admin login with Microsoft Entra ID authentication and preserve authorization for state-changing operations. Review PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/Pages/Login.cshtml.cs, PhotoAlbum/Pages/Login.cshtml, and page handlers that perform protected actions. Do not treat the configured default username as a password finding; remove local credentials only as part of the supported identity migration.

tasks.description: Add application telemetry and operational monitoring through Azure Monitor. Addresses assessment issues: None; the assessment did not identify an observability finding.
tasks.reason: Centralized telemetry and service health signals are needed to operate the modernized cloud application.
tasks.requirements: Instrument application traces, metrics, and logs for Azure Monitor/Application Insights using OpenTelemetry. Review PhotoAlbum/Program.cs, PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj, and infra/main.bicep. Authenticate using managed identity where supported; do not commit instrumentation keys. Define useful failure and availability alerts.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before release. Addresses assessment issues: None; the assessment's hardcoded-sensitive-data finding was not confirmed as a hardcoded password.
tasks.reason: Security and dependency vulnerability remediation is a required part of every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Scan application and test dependencies after the .NET 10 and Azure transformations. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions; document breaking changes for any required major upgrade; verify the build and tests. Review the current security-related deployment settings in infra/main.bicep, especially public networking, ACR admin access, and broad firewall rules, and recommend least-privilege replacements.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification. Addresses assessment issues: Local or network IO operations detected; Local application configuration detected; Connection string is detected; SQL database connection detected; Connection strings without configuration builders detected.
tasks.reason: Post-migration verification is included using the questionnaire's mock-mode default because no provisioned target environment was identified.
tasks.requirements: Consume the frozen baseline and infra-decision-table from 002-setupBaseline. Verify migrated upload, retrieval, deletion, Azure SQL persistence, authentication/authorization, and configuration paths using mocked Azure dependencies. Exercise the affected application and test files, including PhotoAlbum.Tests/Unit/Services/PhotoServiceTests.cs, and report any behavior differences from baseline.
